comparison.objective: Remove a worn toothbrush head, discard it, and push-fit a new head; candidate transfers an LM block to a jig.
comparison.physical_skill: Record tests one-hand stabilization, axial press-fit extraction/insertion, package opening, and disposal. Candidate tests flush rail–jig alignment and continuous race support during sliding.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires the new head fully seated, worn head in the bin, pack state where applicable, and arm return. Candidate requires complete transfer without any lost ball, support separation, inclination, contamination, or damage.
comparison.reason: Axial push-fit replacement is a terminal removal/insertion operation, not a continuous supported carriage transfer.
